column1: # Custom partition table for SmartSwitchD2 (based on zigbee_zczr
# Firmware slots (app0/app1) grown to 0x170000 (1.4375 MB each) and the sounds
# partition (spiffs) shrunk to 0xFA000 (1000 KB) — firmware is prioritised and has
# room to grow; sounds still holds the ~720 KB of MP3s with headroom.
# The Zigbee partitions (zb_storage/zb_fct/rcp_fw) keep their original offsets so the
# device's Zigbee pairing survives the repartition. Build with PartitionScheme=custom.
